description: Find the connected viewer's accepted Watch+ groups by group or member name, such as Jenna. Returns current accepted member IDs, display names and app usernames, never emails or pending invitees. Use these IDs for the people watching now, then recommend_for_group. Match usernames to distinguish duplicate names; when the same people share several groups, prefer the smallest matching group unless the viewer names one. Proceed directly when the people are clear. Requires watchplus:read permission.

query.description: Optional group or accepted member name, such as Jenna. Finds only the connected viewer's accepted Watch+ groups.
query.title: Query
